# Third-party image I/O

`stb_image.h` and `stb_image_write.h` are copied from the `lib/` directory of
[tgautam03/xFilters](https://github.com/tgautam03/xFilters), which vendors
[nothings/stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb).

Their complete license notices remain embedded in the headers. These libraries
provide image decoding and PNG encoding; convolution is implemented in this project.
